raw_segments.text: Portia, if this were true, then should I know this secret?
I grant I am a woman, but with all a woman that Lord Brutus took to wife.
I grant I am a woman, but with all a woman well reputed, Cotto's daughter.
Think you I am no stronger than my sex, being so fathered and so husbanded.
Tell me your counsels, I will not disclose them.
